limitations: Array SHA-256 equality tests exact FP32 byte identity; unequal hashes alone do not quantify cross-platform error magnitude. Each platform's full maximum/RMS errors to the identical GPU fixture are retained.
Windows and Linux compiler/ABI/library builds may choose different reductions or kernels.
Linux ran under WSL with concurrent functional jobs; neither platform run records throughput or latency.
